I'm Sakshi — a product designer who cares about intention & detail

Currently designing at Juspay in Bengaluru. Previously at Intentionally Designed Solutions.

About Me

I believe that great design goes beyond interfaces. Diving into the minute details — understanding the problem deeply, questioning assumptions, and refining every interaction — is what makes the experience truly exceptional.

My process is rooted in research and empathy. I conduct user interviews, usability testing, and competitive analysis to arrive at solutions that are both user-friendly and aligned with business goals.

When I'm not designing, you'll find me exploring new tools, experimenting with creative side projects, or learning something new about the craft.
